account.riskPolicy: existing BOO risk-policy/risk-budget plus operator-tightened limits

candidates.name: ROLLING_CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXECUTION_VALUE
candidates.hypothesis: A completed breakout is worth taking only when its surplus above the signal reference is large relative to structural-stop downside and pre-fixed conservative round-trip costs.
rules: use only signal reference, completed trigger close, setup low, completed ATR14 and exchange tick known at trigger completion
exclude next-open price, future MFE and all later bars from the score
rank against completed scores in the trailing seven days with no later timestamp
require at least 20 causal observations and percentile >= 0.60 as the only new gate
preserve next-open execution, structural stop, solveQuantity quantity and all account protections

holdoutPolicy: Do not open walk-forward or reserved holdout unless C33 passes every development gate.
